findings.proposedFix: redact: sanitize config before dump - drop/redact api_key/secret/token/password/credential keys; keep only safe keys (paths, codes, IDs)
findings.what: json.dump(config, f, indent=2) writes the entire user config dict to resume_config_*.json
findings.whySensitive: If config.json holds alma.api_key / aws secret / token fields, they are written verbatim in plaintext to an output file

findings.proposedFix: change-log-level: set FileHandler to INFO (or guard DEBUG); combined with redacting exception logging
findings.what: logging.FileHandler at DEBUG writes alma_upload_*.log capturing all records incl. str(e) error lines
findings.whySensitive: DEBUG file logs aggregate exception text from lines 344/499 etc.

findings.proposedFix: store error code/type only, not str(e)
findings.whySensitive: Stores raw Alma API exception text which may carry auth/endpoint detail

findings.what: logger.error(f"Upload failed for {filename}: {e}") (also lands in file log)
findings.whySensitive: boto3 error may leak bucket/AWS config

findings.proposedFix: redact: write error type/code only, strip paths
findings.what: writer.writerow([..., result.error or '']) writes error strings to rename_report_*.tsv
findings.whySensitive: result.error may contain OS error messages with FS paths

findings.proposedFix: document input must not contain sensitive data; optional column whitelist
findings.what: writer.writerows(unprocessed_records) copies input TSV rows to resume_tsv_*.tsv
findings.whySensitive: If input TSV has PII beyond MMS_ID, it is copied verbatim

findings.proposedFix: document output contains folder names; optional anonymization
findings.what: writer.writerow([folder, ...]) writes filesystem folder names to folder_match_report_*.tsv
findings.whySensitive: Folder names may embed patron IDs/PII

findings.proposedFix: document output classification; review 907 content for PII
findings.whySensitive: MARC 907 paths could embed identifying info depending on catalog practice

result.notes: Primary actual-leak: resume_helper.py:354 unfiltered json.dump of user config to resume_config_*.json. All writes target ./output. DEBUG FileHandler aggregates exception text. Overlaps with output-paths findings at lines 344/499 (same root: logging str(e)).
